title: Čech cohomology, Stokes' theorem and the de Rham theorem
summary: Refinement of covers and Čech cohomology; fine sheaves and the acyclicity of the sheaf of p-forms (§27, Definition 27.2); the Poincaré lemma implies that Čech and de Rham cohomology agree (§28); orientation, integration and Stokes' theorem from Hitchin §7; Smale's immersion theorem (lecture 35) as further reading.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 33–34 of the 18.965 notes (§26.1, §27, Definition 27.2, §28) with Hitchin §7.1–7.2 for orientation and Stokes' theorem; lecture 35 is optional further reading.

preparation.description: Read lecture 33: §26.1 refinement and §27 the acyclicity of the sheaf of p-forms, Definition 27.2 (fine sheaf).
Read lecture 34: §28 the Poincaré lemma implies the equality of Čech and de Rham cohomology.
Read Hitchin §7.1 (orientation) and §7.2 (Stokes' theorem), which the synthesis project uses to illustrate the theorem on a surface.
